method: Inspected actual PNG captures through image viewer at native/full and contact-sheet scale; semantic tests cover input and geometry, not physical mouse operation.
findings: No viewport/header/sidebar overlap in tested sizes
Normal labels avoid each other and stay inside viewport
Replay timeline and completed status visible
Settings controls and labels share ordering
Ground truth mode explicitly labeled; default survivor markers require publication
limitations: Optional all-decision labels may overlap around the shared dock
Co-located drones share glyph positions; fleet list provides selection
Replay list clips extra rows beyond available panel height with disclosure
